metadata.title: बस्तर से नक्सल हिंसा मिटा देंगे | सुंदरराज पी, आईजी बस्तर रेंज | Interview - Sundarraj P
metadata.description: In a hard-hitting interview with Main Bhi Bharat, IG of the Bastar Range, Sundarraj P, responds to pressing questions from Editor Shyam Sunder on the ongoing anti-Maoist operations in Chhattisgarh. Are security forces under political or administrative pressure to eliminate Maoism by March 2026? Are these pressures leading to mistakes and extra-judicial killings in the name of encounters? Shyam Sunder also raises questions about whether the top police leadership is turning a blind eye to alleged atrocities committed against tribals during operations. Watch this exclusive conversation from the heart of Bastar as the IG speaks on ground realities, strategy, and the human cost of the long conflict.
